name: Founder Technology Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Founder Technology Group Co.,Ltd. (FTG) is a Chinese enterprise that offers a broad spectrum of hardware and software solutions. A core aspect of its business involves the research, development, manufacturing, and distribution of Printed Circuit Board (PCB) products. These PCBs serve diverse sectors, including telecommunications, information technology, industrial medical applications, automotive electronics, and consumer devices. FTG also extends its services to institutions and communities by providing broadband internet access and a range of supplementary value-added offerings. Furthermore, the company is a significant provider of tailored application solutions and seamless system integration for financial entities such as banks, insurance providers, and securities firms. Its expertise also extends to the transportation industry, where it delivers specialized technology services, including automated fare collection systems. Beyond these, FTG offers consulting expertise to government bodies, supplies educational products and comprehensive solutions, and develops solutions for urban management challenges. Established in 1985, the company's headquarters are located in Shanghai, China.
